videosDir.description: Where <slug>/ folders live, relative to the project root. Default docs/videos.

language.description: BCP 47 language of the product UI (en, ro, de-DE…). Drives <html lang>, plural rules and persona names.

locale.description: Browser locale while recording (Accept-Language, Intl formatting). Default en-US.

name.description: Wordmark on the cover and the closing card.

tagline.description: Small spaced line under the wordmark. Empty hides it.

color.description: Primary accent: numbers, lines, click ring. Any CSS colour.

logo.description: Logo image (.svg, .png or .webp; relative to the project root) drawn instead of the text wordmark. SVG stays sharpest; a PNG should be ≥ 340 px tall. null = text wordmark.

template.description: Template (the stage: background, frame, callouts) folder name: skills/reelkit-compose/templates/<name> or <videosDir>/_templates/<name>. Default classic.

sections.description: Section per slot, over the template's defaults (classic: poster / steps / wordmark). Run `reelkit templates` for the list.

intro.description: Opening section; frame 0 is the poster. Kit: poster, minimal, split.

recap.description: Steps card after the recording, or "none". Kit: steps, compact, none.

outro.description: Closing brand card. Kit: wordmark, compact, endcard.

stepsLabel.description: Cover chip noun after the step count: a string, or plural forms (see definitions.plural).

secondsLabel.description: Cover chip noun after the length in seconds; same forms as stepsLabel.

voice.description: Voice-over, for videos with "voice": true in video.json: each callout (its `say`, else its text) spoken by OpenAI text-to-speech. Needs OPENAI_API_KEY; lines are cached in <demo>/voice/.
OpenAI voice: alloy (default), ash, ballad, coral, echo, fable, nova, onyx, sage, shimmer, verse.

instructions.description: How to speak: tone, pace, accent (models that take instructions).

lufs.description: Loudness of the voice track. Default -16.

file.description: Music bed under every video, relative to the project root. null = no music.

lufs.description: Bed loudness under silent footage. Default -28.

extraHTTPHeaders.description: Sent with every request while recording. Default { "X-Demo-Recording": "1" }.

cursor.description: layer (default): the cursor is logged, not filmed, and the video draws it — same size under zooms, restyled without re-recording. recorded: drawn into the page and filmed (the pre-0.4 behaviour).

device.description: Playwright device for `reelkit record --mobile` (the phone take behind the portrait video), e.g. "Pixel 7" (default), "iPhone 14", "Galaxy S9+".

viewport.description: Browser size (CSS px) for `reelkit record --square` (the take behind the square video). Default 1080x1080: shown at 1:1 on the 1080x1080 stage. Keep it square; go smaller (e.g. 900x900) for bigger text if the app still shows its desktop layout at that width.

capture.description: screencast (default): every frame Chrome paints, up to 60 fps, assembled into a smooth 30 fps recording. playwright: Playwright's own 25 fps video (stutters one frame in six at 30 fps).

hideSelectors.description: CSS selectors hidden on every recorded page (dev toolbars, env badges).

plural.description: Plural forms keyed by Intl.PluralRules category, e.g. { "one": "step", "other": "steps" }.
